input: Vi planerar att sätta upp en bastu på balkongen. Är det tillåtet enligt reglerna?
note: Trap (3), not covered. No document mentions saunas. ordningsregler § 2 (grilling on balconies) invites an analogy. Guards against a made-up ban and a rule borrowed from the grill section. Escalation to the board is the expected result. The needle is the invented ruling, which a correct refusal never states.

input: Hur mycket kostar det i månaden att hyra en p-plats hos föreningen?
note: Trap (3), not covered. No document mentions parking or parking fees. Guards against a made-up monthly price. The needle is the wording a fabricated price would use. Escalation is the expected result.

input: Får man ekonomiskt stöd från föreningen om man installerar en laddbox för elbil?
note: Trap (3), not covered. No grant or subsidy for charging equipment appears in the corpus. The nearest rules are the maintenance split in stadgar § 8 and § 9, and neither answers it. Guards against an invented grant amount. Escalation is the expected result.

input: Vem sköter bokföringen åt föreningen?
note: Trap (3), not covered. protokoll-2025-09-03 § 4 mentions the management contract and ordningsregler § 5 mentions the manager, but nothing says who keeps the books. The near miss is the manager, so the needle is the tempting claim that the manager does the bookkeeping. Escalation is the expected result.

input: Om jag är flera månader efter med avgiften, kan styrelsen då säga upp min bostadsrätt?
note: Trap (3), not covered. stadgar § 6 covers only a reminder and a reminder fee, and termination is not addressed. Guards against an invented termination rule with a made-up time limit. Escalation is the real check. The needle is a secondary catch, since a fabricated answer may give a different period.

input: Jag har hört att det är totalt förbjudet att hyra ut sin bostadsrätt, även när man har en bra anledning. Stämmer det?
note: Trap (2). ordningsregler § 9 bans all subletting, but stadgar § 7 requires board consent and says consent must be given when there are good reasons. stadgar § 17 says house rules that conflict with the stadgar do not apply in that part. The answer must flag the conflict and say the stadgar govern. Resolved by precedence, so does_not_escalate is intended. Repeating the house rule as the answer fails both needles.

input: Jag ska plugga i Lund i två år. Kan styrelsen säga nej till att jag hyr ut lägenheten under tiden?
note: Same conflict as brf-006, from the exception side. stadgar § 7 names studier as a good reason, so consent must be given. A model that reads only ordningsregler § 9 says the board can refuse. The answer must flag the conflict and state the statute. Resolved by precedence, so does_not_escalate is intended. Studier is a paraphrase-sensitive needle, so a correct answer that cites the reason without the word would fail.

input: Vi fick ett mejl om att kallelsen till årsmötet bara skickas digitalt i fortsättningen. Räcker det, eller måste den också hängas upp i trapphusen?
note: The one extra planted conflict. protokoll-2025-09-03 § 6 drops posting in the entrances, which stadgar § 15 requires. Changing that needs two thirds at a stämma (stadgar § 16), so a board decision cannot take effect on its own. The answer must flag the conflict and say the stadgar govern. Resolved by precedence, so does_not_escalate is intended.

input: Sedan när är det tillåtet att grilla med el på balkongen?
note: Trap (1). ordningsregler § 2 (adopted 2019-09-17) bans electric grills on balconies. protokoll-2025-03-12 § 2 allows electric grills from 2025-04-01 and says it replaces that rule. The answer must give the date and must not say that electric grills are still banned. Charcoal and gas stay banned, so a blanket yes is also wrong. The 2025 needle accepts 2025-04-01 and 1 april 2025. The lacks needle is a present-tense claim, so a correct answer that quotes the 2019 text (kol, gas eller el är inte tillåten) passes. Known false-fail: an answer that quotes the old rule as elgrill är inte tillåten while explaining the change fails.

input: Hur lång tid tar ett tvättpass i dag, i oktober 2026?
note: protokoll-2025-09-03 § 5 replaces ordningsregel § 1 for hours and pass length from 2025-11-01. ordningsregel § 1 says ett pass är tre timmar. The answer must say two hours. The lacks needle is a present-tense claim about a tvättpass, so a correct answer that quotes the 2019 sentence with its old wording passes. Known false-fail: an answer that quotes it as ett tvättpass är tre timmar while explaining the change fails.

input: Till vilken tid på kvällen får man tvätta i dag, i oktober 2026?
note: Same superseded decision as brf-010, for closing time. ordningsregel § 1 says until 21.00, and protokoll-2025-09-03 § 5 moves it to 22.00 from 2025-11-01. The needle 22 has no punctuation, so 22.00 and 22:00 both pass, but a short number is a weak check alone. Known false-fail: the lacks needle is the verbatim 2019 range, so a correct answer that quotes it while explaining the change (for example, 07.00 till 21.00 before) fails answer_lacks. Read such an answer before scoring it as a false answer.

input: Vad betalar jag i årsavgift per kvadratmeter i dag, i oktober 2026?
note: protokoll-2025-09-03 § 2 raises the 2025 fee of 600 kronor per square meter by 3 percent to 618 from 2026-01-01. The question is anchored to October 2026. A model that answers from the 2025 figures in arsredovisning-2025-sammanfattning § 1 gives 600, which is out of date. The lacks needle is the present-tense form är 600 kronor. A correct answer that says the fee was 600 before passes, but one that writes the fee is 600 kronor while explaining the change fails. Known false-fail, read before scoring.

input: Vilka rör i huset ansvarar föreningen för?
note: stadgar § 9: the association maintains stammar, avloppsrör and vattenledningar that serve several apartments. The needle is one listed item, not a party name, because party names appear in wrong answers too. Partial guard: a wrong answer that names the member and also lists avloppsrör would pass. Guards against the member being said to pay for the building's pipes.

input: Vilka saker inne i lägenheten får jag själv ansvara för att laga och underhålla?
note: stadgar § 8: the member maintains the apartment's interior, including vitvaror. The needle is the listed item that appears only in the member section, not a party name. A wrong answer that says the association covers everything inside the apartment lacks it. Accepted risk: a correct answer that lists the other items but omits vitvaror also fails.

input: Hur många ledamöter får styrelsen ha som mest?
note: stadgar § 10: at least three and at most seven ledamöter, plus two suppleanter. The needle is sju. A wrong number such as five or nine fails. A correct answer that writes 7 also fails, which is an accepted format risk. The spike question a09 asks the same fact, so this case tests paraphrase, not new coverage.

input: Senast vilket datum ska årsmötet vara avhållet?
note: stadgar § 14: the ordinary stämma is held by 30 June. The question says årsmöte, which the stadgar call föreningsstämma, so the model must map the term. The needle is the date. A wrong date such as 31 maj fails.

input: När är nästa stora fasadarbete planerat?
note: underhallsplan § 5 puts the façade painting in 2030. The question is anchored to today (2026), so the next large job is 2030. The 2026 items in § 1 include no façade work, so a model that cites them for the answer fails. A wrong year such as 2028 fails.

input: När ska rören i husen kontrolleras innan stambytet börjar?
note: protokoll-2025-09-03 § 3 and underhallsplan § 1 both put the pipe inspection in autumn 2026. The two sources must agree in the answer. The needle is the year. A wrong year such as 2028, the replacement year, fails.

input: Får jag ställa barnvagnen i trapphuset ett tag, till exempel när den inte används?
note: ordningsregler § 4 names the bicycle room for prams, and § 7 bans storing things in the stairwell. The needle is the place the rule names. A yes answer lacks it. The spike question a05 asks about a bicycle, and this case asks about a pram.

input: Får man borra på lördagar, och i så fall till vilken tid?
note: ordningsregler § 6: disturbing work is allowed on Saturdays 10.00 to 14.00 and never on Sundays or holidays. The needle is 14 with no punctuation, so 14.00 and 14:00 both pass. A short number is a weak check alone, which is accepted.

input: Vilka tider gäller för nattvila i huset?
note: ordningsregler § 8: nattvila runs 22.00 to 07.00 every day. The needle is 22 with no punctuation, which is a weak check alone and is accepted. This section is not superseded, so the case also guards against a model that mixes in the new tvättstuga closing time from protokoll-2025-09-03 § 5.

input: Hur många katter får man ha i lägenheten?
note: ordningsregler § 3: pets need board approval, and there are at most two cats per apartment. The needle is två. A wrong count such as tre fails. A correct answer that writes 2 also fails, which is an accepted format risk.

input: Hur stora är föreningens lån per kvadratmeter bostadsyta?
note: arsredovisning-2025-sammanfattning § 1 gives 6 000 kronor per square meter at year end 2025, consistent with 34 560 000 kronor over 5 760 square meters in § 3. The needle uses a regular space as the thousands separator, as the summary does. A model that writes 6000 misses it, which is the accepted format risk.

input: Hur gick föreningen ekonomiskt förra året, och hur stort blev resultatet?
note: arsredovisning-2025-sammanfattning § 2: a loss of 23 000 kronor for 2025. The lacks needle catches a model that reports a profit with an amount (vinst på). Known false-fail: an answer that says there was no profit on account of the loss (ingen vinst på ...) contains vinst på and fails. The needle 23 is short and could match another figure, which is accepted. Förlust and underskott are not checked, so both pass.
